BankMatchReason.description: Why a credit movement was paired with an invoice. Ascending value = descending confidence; the matcher offers the lowest value that applies.
BankMatchReason.title: BankMatchReason

ContributionLineKind.description: The lines a micro-entrepreneur's URSSAF declaration is settled in, each a rate on the same collected base.
ContributionLineKind.title: ContributionLineKind

Currency.description: The currencies an account can be denominated in. Backed by the ISO 4217 code rather than an int — unlike every other enum here — because the code *is* the identifier the rest of the stack speaks: moneyphp, `Intl.NumberFormat`, and the `char(3)` columns all round-trip it verbatim.  Every case must have an ISO minor unit of 2, because storage is `*_cents` columns and the whole codebase reads them as hundredths. CurrencyTest enforces it, so adding JPY (0 decimals) or TND (3) fails the suite rather than quietly mis-stating amounts by two orders of magnitude.
Currency.title: Currency

DateFormat.description: The numeric layout calendar dates are displayed in — 31/08/2026 or 2026-08-31. Only digit-only dates follow this preference; weekday and month names follow the account locale.
DateFormat.title: DateFormat

DeadlineItemType.description: What one line of the Échéances timeline is. The order of the cases is also the order two lines sharing a due date sort in: an invoice first, then the relance it calls for, then the fisc.
DeadlineItemType.title: DeadlineItemType

ExpenseTodoKind.description:
The cards of the journal's « À traiter » rail. | | |---| | `0`
A subscription's debit was recorded; the receipt is still to be linked. | | `1`
A debit that names a subscription but that no expense explains. | | `2`
An annual subscription debits within the month. |
ExpenseTodoKind.title: ExpenseTodoKind

ExpenseVatStatus.description:
Where a purchase's TVA stands with the CA3. Derived on every read from the receipt, the claim period and the declared months — never stored, so un-marking a declaration honestly flips the rows back. | | |---| | `0`
Receipted and waiting for its CA3 to be declared. | | `1`
Its CA3 was marked declared: the deduction is filed. | | `2`
Claimed on a later CA3 than the purchase month, by choice or because that month was already declared. | | `3`
No receipt: the fisc refuses the deduction until one is attached. | | `4`
Autoliquidation: due and deducted on the same CA3, nothing to recover. | | `5`
Exempt purchase, a receipt whose TVA is not tracked, or an account that files no CA3. |
ExpenseVatStatus.title: ExpenseVatStatus

ExpenseVatTreatment.description:
How the TVA on a purchase reaches the CA3. The receipt decides, never the supplier's country: a foreign SaaS billing through a European entity with 20 % on the invoice is Domestic. | | |---| | `0`
A French invoice carrying TVA at the stated rate. | | `1`
An EU supplier who invoiced without TVA against the intra-community number (autoliquidation). | | `2`
A non-EU supplier who invoiced without TVA (autoliquidation). | | `3`
No TVA at all: insurance, bank fees, stamps, CFE. |
ExpenseVatTreatment.title: ExpenseVatTreatment

FiscalDeadlineKind.description:
The recurring French fiscal deadlines the app tracks. Declaration and payment share a case wherever they share a date, which is every case here: URSSAF télépaie on the declaration date, and the CA3 is due and paid the same day. | | |---| | `0`
| | `1`
| | `2`
| | `3`
| | `4`
| | `5`
The 2042-C PRO, keyed by the year of income it declares. |
FiscalDeadlineKind.title: FiscalDeadlineKind

FixedPriceBudgetState.description: How much of a forfait its tracked time has eaten, as three states rather than a raw percentage: the threshold that separates them is a product decision, and resolving it here keeps every screen — banner, tile, badge, « À traiter » — reading the same one. Labels live on the frontend, like every other enum here.
FixedPriceBudgetState.title: FixedPriceBudgetState

IncomeTaxReturnBox.description:
Where the micro-BNC receipts go on the 2042-C PRO. | | |---| | `0`
Case 5TE — the versement libératoire was opted for; the tax is already paid. | | `1`
Case 5HQ — no option; the receipts join the household's taxable income after the abatement. |
IncomeTaxReturnBox.title: IncomeTaxReturnBox

InvoiceForecastBucket.description: The bars of "Attendu sur 60 jours". Money already late is not one of them: it is not expected, it is missing, and it is reported on its own as `overdue`. Keeping it here would both duplicate that figure and scale the bars against a bar nobody draws.
InvoiceForecastBucket.title: InvoiceForecastBucket

InvoiceTodoKind.description: What the "À traiter" list can put in front of you: money that was billed and has not come in, money that was worked and has not been billed, and a forfait whose time is running out or has already run over. Drafts are not here — an unsent draft is a note to self, not a debt. Labels live on the frontend, like every other enum here.
InvoiceTodoKind.title: InvoiceTodoKind

RevenueBasis.description:
The two ways a freelancer reads their revenue: by what was invoiced, or by what actually landed. URSSAF declares on the cash basis; the invoiced basis is the activity view. | | |---| | `0`
Issued invoices, summed on their issue date. | | `1`
Paid invoices, summed on their payment date. |
RevenueBasis.title: RevenueBasis

SubscriptionOccurrenceState.description:
One square of the twelve-month strip. | | |---| | `0`
The debit has its expense and the expense its receipt. | | `1`
The debit has its expense, still waiting for the receipt. | | `2`
| | `3`
A future debit that will not happen while the subscription is paused. | | `4`
A past debit with no expense — before the subscription was recorded, or not auto-created. |
SubscriptionOccurrenceState.title: SubscriptionOccurrenceState
